name: Rebuild kernel with nftables
command: cd /home/ganshun/k4s && export PATH=/tmp/dwarves-root/usr/bin:$PATH && make -C linux O=$PWD/build/kernel-cni tinyconfig >/dev/null && cat configs/k4s-tiny.config configs/k4s-cni.config >> build/kernel-cni/.config && make -C linux O=$PWD/build/kernel-cni olddefconfig >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "--- options that took ---" && grep -E '^CONFIG_(XFRM_USER|CGROUP_NET_CLASSID|NF_TABLES|NF_TABLES_INET|NFT_COMPAT|NETFILTER_XTABLES)=' build/kernel-cni/.config && echo "--- options that did NOT take (the silent-drop trap) ---" && for o in NF_TABLES NF_TABLES_INET NF_TABLES_IPV4 NFT_COMPAT CGROUP_NET_CLASSID XFRM_USER; do grep -qE "^CONFIG_$o=" build/kernel-cni/.config || echo "  DROPPED: $o"; done; make -C linux O=$PWD/build/kernel-cni -j$(nproc) bzImage 2>&1 | tail -2 && ls -l build/kernel-cni/arch/x86/boot/bzImage
